content.title: Dawson Geophysical: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: MIDLAND, Texas (AP) — Dawson Geophysical Co. (DWSN) on Tuesday reported a loss of $2.3 million in its second quarter. On a per-share basis, the Midland, Texas-based company said it had a loss of 8 cents. The provider of onshore seismic data services for the oil and gas industry posted revenue of $9.9 million in the period.
